subject: Human Evolution
title: Ancient DNA Revolution
description: A 60-second lesson on Ancient DNA Revolution.

hook.text: Svante Pääbo spent 40 years figuring out how to read DNA from fossils. In 2022, he won the Nobel Prize.

buildup.text: Ancient DNA degrades into tiny fragments. Contamination from modern humans is a constant threat.

discovery.text: Pääbo's team sequenced the Neanderthal genome in 2010, proving interbreeding with modern humans.

twist.text: They also found Denisovans—a species identified entirely from DNA, not from skeletal anatomy.

climax.text: Ancient DNA has rewritten human history more in 15 years than fossils did in the previous century.

punchline.text: A Nobel Prize for reading the dead's mail.

quiz.question: Who won the Nobel Prize for ancient DNA research?
